plan.title: Order Activity records Convert to Auction

steps.note: Start a new eRFX event that can be configured as an RFQ.
Configure the event with a published RFQ stage, which is required for conversion.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Add a QA test vendor so the event can be published.
Publish the RFQ so conversion is available.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Perform the conversion action whose activity record is under test.
Reopen the plan's original event page to inspect its activity history.
Open the Activity drawer from the stage Settings menu.
Verify the activity history contains the conversion action.
